subject: general
question: Which of the following country has become the first country in the world to accept bitcoin as legal currency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**El Salvador.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Central American country of El Salvador has approved** a bill to make the world's largest and most popular **cryptocurrency, bitcoin, the legal currency of the country.**
 
• It has become the** first country in the world to declare bitcoin as a legal currency.**
 
• The **official currency of El Salvador is the US Dollar.**
 
• The US dollar will continue to be the legal currency in the country as before and **the use of bitcoin will be optional.**
 
• In El-Salvador's parliament, bitcoin was approved by a vote of 84 to 62.
 
• After this announcement,** the price of bitcoin increased from $33.98 to $34,398.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bitcoin is a type of digital currency, or cryptocurrency**, that enables instant payments.
 
• Bitcoin was **introduced to the world in the year 2009.**
 
• It is based on an open-source protocol.
 
• It is not issued by any central authority.
